purpose: Judge actual report purpose, scope, source grounding and separate recovery/defect status, not just heading words.

writer-combined-incident-bug: One useful combined record; complete primary defect fields, supplied impact and UTC timeline, response and actual recovery checks. No duplicate artificial documents.
Preserve exact build42, HTTP500, website17, Research/Education, times and actual3 checks. Recovery is verified, permanent fix/cause/files/tests remain unresolved/uninspected/not run.
Natural prose, appropriate structure and no fabricated severity, owner, evidence or execution.
writer-qa-bug-without-incident: Produce the requested defect report with separate expected/actual results, How to reproduce and Relevant files; retain one observation and unknown repeatability.
Do not invent an outage, response/recovery timeline or mandatory incident report solely because a staging defect exists. No guessed cause or file path.
writer-incident-linked-defects: Recommend distinct linked event/defect records for different histories, preserve both references, link rather than duplicate evidence.
Review stays recommendations, not full replacements or fabricated status/verification.
